description: Source code for OpenAI Realtime LLM context and aggregator implementations, including classes for managing real-time conversation context, message conversion, and frame processing within a larger AI system.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: Extends OpenAILLMContext to support real-time session management, message conversion, and conversation history handling.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles user input frames and manages context updates for real-time conversations, including message updates and tool settings.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Processes assistant output frames, filters duplicate texts, and manages function call results in real-time context.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext with optional messages and tools.

methods.name: __setup_local
methods.description: Sets up local session flags and instructions.

methods.name: upgrade_to_realtime
methods.description: Converts a standard OpenAILLMContext to a realtime context.

methods.name: from_standard_message
methods.description: Converts a standard message dictionary into a conversation item for realtime API.

methods.name: get_messages_for_initializing_history
methods.description: Prepares conversation history for session initialization, handling system and user messages.

methods.name: add_user_content_item_as_message
methods.description: Adds a user content item as a message to the context.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling realtime-specific frame types.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Handles pushing user input aggregation; currently a no-op.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles function call result frames and updates the realtime context.
